Neil, saw Mployer published its benefit plan design study across 50,000+ employer plans and relaunched the ratings badges for 2026.

That much new market signal usually surfaces more in-market employers than the team can cover before interest fades, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Mployer off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Neil, quick follow-up for Mployer.

When a data study draws inbound interest, the warm employers usually outnumber what reps can personalize, so the best ones get a generic touch or none at all. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to convert that interest into the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Mployer needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Mployer's reply rate likely compares to other benefits-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
